declared: before any cycle-2 R3 development run
purpose: Held-out conditions for confirming the cycle-2 R3 design (protocol v1.3.0). Not used for development.
rule: PASS iff median HV(R3) > median HV(NSGA-II) in at least 6 of 8 cells; STRONG iff additionally median HV(R3) > max HV(NSGA-II) in at least 6 of 8 cells; otherwise FAIL.
multiplicity_note: This is the second confirmatory cycle. Cycle 1 (H1-H4, seeds 101-107) failed 2/8 and is now development data.
